findings: All acceptance cases with valid inputs produce correct results via Math.max(0,Math.ceil((deadlineMs-nowMs)/1000))
Type guard correctly rejects non-number types (string, null, boolean) via typeof check
Negative value check correctly throws for deadlineMs<0 and nowMs<0
No imports, no time reads, no side effects, no external resources
Self-contained single TypeScript module with a single named export
Edge case nowMs>deadlineMs returns 0 via Math.max
Fractional ms case [1000.5,1000] returns Math.ceil(0.5/1000)=1 correctly

summary: Implements remainingTimerSeconds(deadlineMs, nowMs) which validates that both inputs are finite nonnegative numbers (throwing on invalid input), then returns Math.max(0, Math.ceil((deadlineMs - nowMs) / 1000)) so that past/reached deadlines return zero and fractional positive seconds round up.
